The '''Project Celestial Power complex''' was a complex in the [[B'ankor Refuge]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. During the early [[Imperial Era]], the facility was operated as part of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Project Celestial Power]], which was publicly declared as focused on renewable energy research, but was actually being used for the Empire's [[superweapon]], the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]].<ref name="Catalyst" />

The facility was built in the area that was formerly the B'ankor Refuge. After the [[B'ankora]] were forcefully [[Relocation of the B'ankora|relocated]], construction of this facility began. Esteemed [[scientist]] [[Galen Walton Erso|Galen Erso]] visited the site while construction was still ongoing and received very preferential treatment during his visit. The building took over ten months to complete. Although some citizens initially objected to the facility being created, Imperial media ensured the downplaying of the project, and the sentiments of the opposition soon passed.<ref name="Catalyst" />

By the facility's completion, it stood a towering, multilevel, cubical masterpiece that was comparable to the [[Helical HyperCom's headquarters|headquarters]] of [[Helical HyperCom]] on the planet [[Lokori]]. It was complete with surveillance towers, air control stations, and a landing field. [[Starfighter]]s were stationed at the facility as a precautionary defense measure. Security around the facility was tight and enforced by the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] in addition to other Imperial agencies of significant standing. In addition to materials, Imperial researchers were constantly ferried in and out of the facility. [[Airspeeder]]s transported such materials around the facility to the smaller landing accommodations on the roof of the building, where they could be moved throughout the building via the vast [[turbolift]]s that descended all the way through the building.<ref name="Catalyst" />

[[File:ErsoOffice-2017DarthVaderAnnual.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Galen Erso's office in the complex]]
In addition to the turbolifts, the inside of the building had many different functions. The upper levels of the facility were used mainly for warehousing. The facility had lower levels as well as sub-bedrock ones where maintenance rooms, power stations, [[laser]] installations, research-and-development centers, [[Laboratory|laboratories]], [[Library|libraries]], and living spaces that could accommodate 2,500 staff were located. Erso himself had his own [[Galen Erso's Office|office]] with a separate library, computer room, communications suite, and [[Ersos' apartment|residence]] for him and [[Erso family|his family]].<ref name="Catalyst" />

Eventually, a [[Project Celestial Power facility|sister facility]] was constructed on the planet [[Malpaz]], hoping to replicate the successes of the complex on Coruscant. However, the researchers at the Malpaz facility had difficulties controlling their kyber crystal, and an [[Malpaz incident|incident]] would destroy the facility along with the neighboring [[Malpaz capital city|metropolis]].<ref name="Catalyst" />
